```yaml

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default

  replicas: 3

  template:
    metadata:

        app: app
    spec:

      - name: hello

      imagePullSecrets:
      - name: reg-auth
```

I will write this configuration to a file and apply it.
